text: LOV-LEDGER-EVENT is loaded with the fourteen values of TSD P3 v3 T5.1 — CONTACT, LETTER, PROMISE, PAYMENT, HANDOVER, CASE_CREATED, CASE_ALLOCATED, CASE_TRANSFERRED, CASE_ESCALATED, DOCUMENT_ATTACHED, DECISION_TAKEN, CORRECTION, PARTNER_RESULT, OFFER — with the Thai labels of DL10, and the two values the legacy story does not list are kept.
why: The legacy story prints twelve values for the list and the higher source under R-PREC prints fourteen; the story reads the list as data and must not drop a value the partner and offer channels need.
read: RWB-E1-066 section 13; TSD P3 v3 T5.1 and T-A.1 (DF-INT-014); Template and Rules R3 (R-PREC)
confirm: Reference data load of wave 1, with the rwb-case reference data owner and Compliance
impact: Two extra list values; no rule, criterion or test changes because the criterion refuses only a code outside the list

text: The required flags of the eight ledger columns are decided with the interaction table of rwb-source-data, and this story sends event code, actor, source, occurred time and the key on every append and reads the case sequence back, so it holds whichever answer that decision gives.
why: The legacy migration makes the ledger columns required and the TSD prints them optional; the table is no longer this service's, so the difference is recorded and left with its owner.
read: RWB-E1-066 section 13; TSD P3 v3 T-A.1 DF-INT-014 to DF-INT-021; Template and Rules R3 (R-PREC)
confirm: Physical schema review of rwb_source_data with the rwb-source-data contract owner
impact: No change in this story; the owner's migration carries the flags

text: The case side keeps one link row per case action in a table interaction_link of schema rwb_case, with the columns case_id, action_ref, event_code, ledger_entry_id, case_seq, decision_log_id, idempotency_key, status, occurred_at, created_at and updated_at; the states are PENDING, COMMITTED and REFUSED; the key is derived from the action reference so a retry reuses it; and the append is asked before the case action commits, with one CORRECTION append as the only repair.
why: No source describes a case-side link, its states, its key or the write order, because the monolith wrote both in one transaction; the two-service act needs all four to keep the legacy promise that a failed write stops the action.
read: RWB-E1-066 sections 4, 12 and 13; RWB-P1-E1066-CON (append, replay, 409, 422, 503); Template and Rules R5.5 DP-01, DP-11, DP-15 and DP-18
confirm: Design review of the rwb-case baseline with the API and physical schema owners, and the Flyway version assignment
impact: One new table and one activity; no business value is invented and no legacy value changes

text: The interaction write and the case-filtered ledger read are not operations of rwb-case after the split: this story provides no REST operation, consumes POST /api/recovery/source-data/v1/interactions, and the recording screens reach it through the contract of RWB-P1-E1066-CON.
why: The TSD keeps the two operations with P3, while the default ruling and the Ownership Map give the ledger to rwb-source-data and its contract publishes the append and the read.
read: TSD P3 v3 T-A.1 API-P3-014 and API-P3-015; Template and Rules R3 (default rulings) and R5.5 DP-18; RWB-P1-E1066-CON 12.1
confirm: API specification review, retiring API-P3-014 and API-P3-015 from the rwb-case document
impact: One provided operation fewer on rwb-case and one consumed operation; the screens and the timeline are unaffected because they call the same owner

text: The BRD Epic 1 v4, the FSD P3 v4 and the TSD P3 v3 read for this work package are treated as the current baselines for drafting even though no approval record was available in the read set, so the story is written in status Draft (realignment v1) and no approval is waited for.
why: The realignment run proceeds without human approval stops, and a missing approval or status is recorded as an assumption instead of blocking the story.
read: Business Requirements Epic 1 v4; FSD P3 v4; TSD P3 v3; root AGENTS.md rules 9 and 10
confirm: Document control of the BRD, FSD and TSD baselines at the verification loop
impact: None on content; the status row stays Draft (realignment v1) until the baselines are confirmed
